import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, itertools
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle

# ---------- data recomputed inline (self-contained) ----------
def af(acc):
    m=requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{acc}",timeout=60).json()[0]
    pdb=requests.get(m["pdbUrl"],timeout=120).text
    rows=[(l[12:16].strip(),l[17:20].strip(),int(l[22:26]),float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54]),float(l[60:66]))
          for l in pdb.split("\n") if l.startswith("ATOM")]
    return pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["aname","res","resi","x","y","z","b"])

Dh=af("Q1L5Z9")
def atom(D,ri):
    s=D[D["resi"]==ri]; rn=s["res"].iloc[0]
    sel={"CYS":["SG"],"HIS":["NE2","ND1"]}.get(rn,["CB"])
    a=s[s["aname"].isin(sel)]
    return rn, a[["x","y","z"]].values

def dmat(D,ris):
    labs=[];pts=[]
    for ri in ris:
        rn,a=atom(D,ri); labs.append(f"{rn[0]}{rn[1:].lower()}{ri}"); pts.append(a)
    n=len(ris); M=np.zeros((n,n))
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            M[i,j]=np.sqrt(((pts[i][:,None]-pts[j][None])**2).sum(-1)).min()
    return labs,M

Nlig=[143,146,158,160,163,166,190,195]; Clig=[449,452,464,466,469,472,483,486]
labN,MN=dmat(Dh,Nlig); labC,MC=dmat(Dh,Clig)

# site counts from the 6 A search (recomputed)
def ligs(D,lo,hi):
    out=[]
    s=D[(D["resi"]>=lo)&(D["resi"]<=hi)]
    for ri,g in s.groupby("resi"):
        rn=g["res"].iloc[0]
        sel={"CYS":["SG"],"HIS":["ND1","NE2"]}.get(rn)
        if sel is None: continue
        a=g[g["aname"].isin(sel)]
        if len(a): out.append((f"{rn[0]}{ri}", a[["x","y","z"]].values))
    return out
def nsites(D,lo,hi,cut=6.0):
    L=ligs(D,lo,hi); hits=[]
    for c in itertools.combinations(range(len(L)),4):
        ds=[float(np.sqrt(((L[i][1][:,None]-L[j][1][None])**2).sum(-1)).min()) for i,j in itertools.combinations(c,2)]
        if max(ds)<=cut: hits.append((max(ds),set(L[i][0] for i in c)))
    kept=[];used=set()
    for m,s in sorted(hits):
        if s&used: continue
        kept.append(s); used|=s
    return len(kept)

PAN=[("LONRF2\nhuman","Q1L5Z9",125,210),("LONRF2\nmouse","F6ZE64",115,205),
     ("LONRF2\nanole","H9GDI3",125,200),("LONRF2\nquail","A0A8C2Y5E1",130,200),
     ("LONRF2\nmedaka","H2LZT2",130,205),("LONRF1\nhuman","Q17RB8",105,180),
     ("LONRF3\nhuman","Q496Y0",145,215)]
cnt=[]
for nm,acc,lo,hi in PAN:
    D=Dh if acc=="Q1L5Z9" else af(acc)
    cnt.append((nm,nsites(D,lo,hi)))
cnt.append(("LONRF2 C-RING\nhuman",nsites(Dh,440,500)))
cnt.append(("RNF4 RING\nhuman",nsites(af("P78317"),130,190)))
print(cnt)
